groups.label: I fell off my bicycle
groups.definition: I lost balance or control while riding my bicycle and came off it onto the ground

groups.label: I crashed my bicycle
groups.definition: I had a bicycle crash that threw or knocked me from the bike

groups.label: I fell while cycling
groups.definition: I came off a bike and hit the ground during a cycling trip

groups.label: I had a bicycle accident
groups.definition: I had an accident while riding a bicycle in which I fell or was thrown off

groups.label: I missed an important train
groups.definition: I arrived too late or otherwise failed to board an important train before it departed

groups.label: I arrived at the station after my train departed
groups.definition: I reached the railway station only after the important train I intended to catch had already left

groups.label: I was stranded after my train left
groups.definition: I was left at the station because the important train I intended to catch had gone

groups.label: I missed an important railway connection
groups.definition: I failed to catch an important connecting train because it departed before I could board

concept: I had an argument with my close friend.
wish: I had an argument with my close friend.

groups.label: I had an argument with my close friend
groups.definition: I had a heated verbal disagreement with a person I considered a close friend

groups.label: I fell out with my close friend
groups.definition: I had a disagreement that created anger or distance between me and my close friend

groups.label: I had a heated disagreement with my close friend
groups.definition: I strongly and emotionally disagreed with my close friend

groups.label: I had a conflict with my close friend
groups.definition: I experienced an upsetting interpersonal conflict with my close friend

groups.label: I got lost on vacation
groups.definition: I was unable to determine where I was or how to reach my destination while away on vacation

groups.label: I became disoriented while on vacation
groups.definition: I lost my sense of direction in an unfamiliar place during my vacation

groups.label: I could not find my way on vacation
groups.definition: I did not know which route to take in an unfamiliar place while on holiday

groups.label: I had navigation trouble on vacation
groups.definition: I was confused about my location and directions while navigating during my vacation

groups.label: I broke my phone
groups.definition: I accidentally damaged my mobile phone so that it was impaired or unusable

groups.label: I cracked my phone screen
groups.definition: I damaged my phone by cracking its glass display

groups.label: I damaged my handset
groups.definition: I physically damaged the mobile device I used

groups.label: I made my mobile phone unusable
groups.definition: I had an accident or impact that left my phone unable to function normally

concept: I moved out of my childhood home.
wish: I moved out of my childhood home.

groups.label: I moved out of my childhood home
groups.definition: I left the home where I grew up and relocated my belongings to live somewhere else

groups.label: I left my childhood home
groups.definition: I ended my residence at the place where I grew up

groups.label: I relocated from my childhood home
groups.definition: I changed residence from the home where I grew up to a different place

groups.label: I packed up and left my childhood home
groups.definition: I packed my possessions and left the house where I grew up to live elsewhere
